idea.title: Posted once, in one place, then silence
idea.angle: One Instagram post and then nothing means most of your audience never sees the listing. It isn't a bad listing; it just never had a chance to be seen.
idea.hook: POSTED ONCE. THEN SILENCE. SOUND FAMILIAR?

slides.heading: IT NEVER HAD A CHANCE TO BE **SEEN**
slides.body: One Instagram post, then nothing. Most of your audience never sees it. They didn't say no. They just missed it.

slides.heading: GOOD LISTINGS THAT **DISAPPEAR**
slides.body: A day later, the post is buried. No messages. You start to think the listing is the problem. It isn't.

slides.heading: SHARE IT IN **FIVE** PLACES
slides.body: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp and property sites. The same video and photos, in the shape each one likes.

slides.heading: **REPOST** YOUR STRONG LISTINGS
slides.body: Most of your followers missed it the first time. Post it again, with a new first line.

slides.heading: POST **EVERY** WEEK
slides.body: A few good posts every week beats ten in one day and then nothing for a month.

slides.heading: YOU DON'T NEED MORE LISTINGS. YOU NEED THEM **SEEN**.
GIVE YOUR LISTING A **SECOND** CHANCE
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
You posted the listing. A day later, nothing. Sound familiar?

It's usually not a bad listing. Most of your audience just never saw it.
Share the same video and photos in five places.
Repost your strong listings, because most followers missed them the first time.
And post a few good listings every week, not ten in one day.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
